what: A white curtain covers the hero, and the photo below shows through only where the black logo letters sit on the curtain (mix-blend lighten). The photo shrinks from 5x to 2.8x over 4s, the logo letters float up from 10px below in sequence at .5s (3.6s back(2)), and a ridge line is drawn from the left over 2s. At 5 seconds the curtain lifts over 1s and the photo settles from 1.3x to 1x over 6s power4.out, and at 5.3 seconds the white logo turns on over 2s. The whole thing is fit to 9 seconds (originally 11 seconds → 1.22x faster).

options.total: Total length (seconds) — timeline.totalDuration, default 9 (0 means the original 11 seconds)
options.from · mid · settle: Photo scale — start 5 · before the curtain lifts 2.8 · as it lifts 1.3 (ends at 1)
options.[data-fx-part=veil]: White curtain (required) — black logo SVG inside. Letters are [data-fx-part=letter] (multiple), ridge·underline use [data-fx-part=stroke], small Latin text uses [data-fx-part=sub]
options.[data-fx-part=mark]: White logo that lights up after the curtain lifts
options.fx:done: Fired from the element when the curtain starts to lift — shows the header and menu buttons at this point and hooks up scroll reveals (original isInSplash release)

note: The original starts after imagesLoaded. This part starts after fonts are ready (document.fonts.ready). The curtain must be a white panel with a black image to be punched through by lighten, so it does not follow the skin color

from.where: index.html #hero + index.js — original Wc() timeline (#heroLogo .textParts · .parts1 · .parts6 · #bg · #heroLogoArea1/2, totalDuration 9)
